caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of an eagle with outstretched wings, perched on a circular base which is mounted on a tall, black, rectangular plinth with sloping sides. The eagle is colored in shades of gold and brown, giving it a metallic appearance, with visible feather details on its wings, chest, and tail. The eagle's head is turned to its right, with a pronounced beak and detailed eyes. The plinth is depicted in deep black with subtle shading to indicate its three-dimensional form and flat surface. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or details. There is a faint signature or inscription in the lower right portion of the image.
title: Door Stop: Eagle
